parameters.name: IncludeTags
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the information of tags. Valid values:

*   false (default value)
*   true

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to obtain the ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager get-resource-group --resource-group-id rg-9gLOoK0000 --include-tags true --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
